data.one_liner: Flutter plugin that lets the cryptography package use native OS crypto APIs for faster, compliant operations.
data.what_it_does: It provides platform‑specific implementations of cryptographic algorithms (AES‑GCM, ChaCha20‑Poly1305, ECDH/ECDSA, etc.) that fall back to Dart or background isolates when needed. The plugin speeds up encryption, decryption, and key operations by calling Android, iOS, and macOS native crypto libraries.
use_when: You need high‑performance or FIPS‑compliant cryptography on Android, iOS, or macOS
You want to off‑load heavy crypto work to native code or background isolates
avoid_when: Your app runs on platforms without native support (e.g., web, Linux, Windows)
You require deterministic pure‑Dart behavior for testing or reproducibility
strengths: Up to 100× speed boost on supported platforms
Automatic fallback to Dart or background isolates
weaknesses: Adds native code and plugin setup
Only works on Android, iOS, macOS; no web support
Potentially easier reverse‑engineering of native calls
